endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2
endpoint.ref_validation: For caller-provided refs, exact ID/URL binding match before credential lookup and HTTP; no redirect or selecting a ref-supplied endpoint

request.body: Typed TerminateClusterSessionBody: exactly one nonempty sessionId or explicit filter; no implicit all-sessions default. Explicit empty filter means all sessions per source. Protected reason reveals only wire.
request.reference: Explicit caller cluster anchor; source sessionId retained as caller exact session ref, filter never adopts session refs
request.precondition: Caller creates documented CNAME pointing to cluster web-publication hostname with TTL300 before calling; SDK performs no DNS changes
request.protected_input: Private wireBody reveals only explicit protected source strings; format=byte/PEM descriptions preserved as caller wire string without implicit base64/X509 conversion

response.mapping: Typed empty TerminateClusterSessionResponse, retained receipt on all errors; acceptance does not prove session termination
response.number_protection: Source JSON numbers are lexically validated and stored in onec.ProtectedNumber without precision conversion; formatting/JSON/Text redacts, Reveal is explicit

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError
errors.lost_response: unknown_outcome with one attempt; no inferred ID, no list/name adoption

retry: no mutation replay on any unknown response

wait.limitation: Source provides no terminated session state or causal completion token; no absence/name lookup success claimed

recovery.observation: Caller may explicitly inspect exact IDs with ListClusterSessions; receipt refs retained, no replay or implicit recovery
